_note: v2.8 plan 69 K8 (no-model lane). Host fact: TurnBridge commits a boundary for every MESSAGE_RECEIVED type except first_message and extension (NON_TURN_MESSAGE_TYPES, runtime/turnBridge.ts, a denylist on purpose); ST's event carries (messageId, type) and an extension that posts a message through addOneMessage and emits MESSAGE_RECEIVED with no type is an untyped emitter. Expected outcome: the synthetic player-like message commits a boundary as an ordinary message, and no rollback. Run: node scripts/debug/so-scenario.mts run test/scenarios/v28-69-k8-synthetic-player.json --sandbox --group 'Group: Arin, DM Narrator', twice. Also v2.8 69 K5: inline hosts sit beside .mes_text and assert-player-clean (which now sweeps .mes_text for SO nodes) finds nothing.

steps.eval: for (const key of Object.keys(globalThis).filter((k) => k.startsWith('storyOrchestratorDebug'))) delete globalThis[key]; globalThis.storyOrchestratorDebugExtractionResponse = 'SCENE_NONE'; const ctx = SillyTavern.getContext(); for (let id = ctx.chat.length - 1; id >= 0; id -= 1) await ctx.deleteMessage(id, undefined, false); if (ctx.chat.length !== 0) throw new Error('the sandbox chat still holds ' + ctx.chat.length + ' message(s)'); return { cleared: true };

steps.eval: const markRt = globalThis.storyOrchestratorRuntime; const ms = markRt.getEngineState(); globalThis.__k8 = { boundary: ms.boundary, last: ms.lastMessageId, length: SillyTavern.getContext().chat.length, recommits: globalThis.storyOrchestratorSpikes?.editReread?.stats().recommits ?? null }; return globalThis.__k8;

const ctx = SillyTavern.getContext(); const message = { name: ctx.name1, is_user: true, is_system: false, send_date: new Date().toISOString(), mes: 'I knock twice on the cellar door.', extra: {} }; ctx.chat.push(message); const id = ctx.chat.length - 1; ctx.addOneMessage(message); await ctx.eventSource.emit(ctx.eventTypes.MESSAGE_RECEIVED, id); await ctx.saveChat(); return { id };

const s = globalThis.storyOrchestratorRuntime.getEngineState(); const k = globalThis.__k8; const id = SillyTavern.getContext().chat.length - 1; if (s.boundary !== k.boundary + 1) throw new Error('expected exactly one boundary for the synthetic message: ' + k.boundary + ' -> ' + s.boundary); if (s.lastMessageId !== id) throw new Error('the boundary did not consume the synthetic message: last=' + s.lastMessageId + ' id=' + id); return { boundary: s.boundary, last: s.lastMessageId };

const hosts = document.querySelectorAll('#chat .mes_block > .so-inline-host').length; const inside = document.querySelectorAll('#chat .mes_text [id^="so-"], #chat .mes_text [class^="so-"], #chat .mes_text [data-so]').length; if (inside) throw new Error(inside + ' SO node(s) inside .mes_text'); return { inlineHosts: hosts, insideMesText: inside };
